evals.name: held-out-ranking-audit
evals.prompt: Check whether the agent's ranking of this week's papers matches my ranking and tell me whether the profile is improving.
evals.expected_output: A held-out comparison reporting precision at k and pairwise agreement, with sample-size caveats and no profile rewrite unless the user asks.
expectations: The predicted ranking is frozen before the human ranking is used.
Metrics are append-only and identify the batch and profile version or hash.
The response does not claim that a small single batch proves stable taste learning.
